image_prompt.text: The connected parkour circuit through the city — rooftop to skybridge to alley and back — with every gap held inside jump range so the loop stays clearable
Wall scrambles and wall jumps up the narrow alleyways between the skyscrapers
Flat skyscraper rooftops carrying yellow glowing pads where runners land and stop safely
A 100x100 stud plaza at the centre of the city where players spawn and set off into the circuit, circular and futuristic with a glowing perimeter
A dense cyberpunk city block grid filling 500x500 studs — 15 interconnected skyscrapers from 40 to 200 studs tall, dark futuristic architecture with neon cyan, magenta and orange accents
Glass skybridges connecting the skyscrapers to each other at multiple heights
Ground level of dark asphalt marked out with glowing neon grid lines

layout_placement.text: Respawn set on the yellow rooftop pads, so a fall drops the runner back onto the last tower rather than the plaza

notes: Preset Tower Obby kept on its own shape course-tower, but two of its options were dropped: obstacle-timing because the prompt bars vanishing/abstract platforms ('NO cubes or strange platforms'), and winner-zone because the course is a closed circuit with no stated end payoff.
P2 kept deliberately: skybridges at multiple heights and rooftops over the alleyways mean the play volume genuinely stacks, so this is not the 'nothing actually overhangs' case.
Hard constraints from the prompt for the image model: no floating platforms outside the city bounds, and no cubes or abstract platforms — only buildings, skybridges, and the central plaza.
would have asked: the yellow glowing pads on the flat rooftops read as checkpoints, so I took them as checkpoint-respawn — confirm they are checkpoints rather than pure decorative lighting.

would have asked: offer was Tower Obby — a stacked skyscraper course, the ordered rooftop-and-skybridge route, alley wall climbs, rooftop checkpoint pads, plus the central spawn plaza and the dense neon city block, minus the timed/vanishing platforms and the end reward area. Want that, or build it up yourself?

would have asked: this routes P6 + P2 because the circuit stacks over itself; the overhang pass is not the proven route, so confirm the multi-height skybridges are wanted rather than a single-level street circuit.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?
